findings.name: Agico Bootstrap
findings.why_relevant: Generic landing page structure could be customized for restaurant promotion, but lacks restaurant-specific features like menus, reservations, or hours.
findings.pass1_reason: Multipurpose landing page could be adapted for restaurant promotion.

findings.name: Airspace Bootstrap
findings.purpose: A generic, clean Bootstrap template for business or agency websites with hero, about, services, portfolio, and contact sections.
findings.why_relevant: It provides a solid responsive layout and basic page sections that can be adapted to display restaurant information, menus, hours, map, and contact/reservation details, but lacks built-in reservation or menu-specific components.
findings.pass1_reason: Generic clean template adaptable to a restaurant customer site.
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Bexer Bootstrap
findings.purpose: A multipurpose business/startup Bootstrap template with sections for services, portfolio, team, and contact.
findings.why_relevant: It provides a clean, responsive foundation that can be customized with restaurant-specific sections such as menu, reservation form, hours, and map, but it is not purpose-built for restaurants.
findings.pass1_reason: Business template could support restaurant sections after customization.
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Bingo Bootstrap
findings.purpose: A free, general-purpose business/agency Bootstrap template with sections for hero, about, services, portfolio, pricing, and contact.
findings.why_relevant: It offers a clean, responsive customer-facing layout that could be adapted to a restaurant site by repurposing sections for menu highlights, hours, reservation call-to-action, and contact/location. It does not include restaurant-specific features like an online booking system or interactive menu, so those would need to be added.
findings.pass1_reason: Free business template with potential for restaurant adaptation.
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Bizcraft Bootstrap
findings.purpose: Multipurpose business template built with Bootstrap.
findings.why_relevant: Can be adapted for a restaurant/tavern by customizing sections for menu, booking, hours, and map, though not purpose-built for food service.
findings.pass1_reason: Multipurpose business template can be adapted for restaurant.
